name: task-worker
description: Provider-neutral work graphs with parallel ready sets, integration gates, and opaque external review ownership.

interface.shortDescription: Decompose, run, and verify provider-neutral work graphs.
interface.longDescription: Defines immutable work graphs, plans every ready leaf and integration candidate from local or provider snapshots, isolates local runs in stable worktrees, and records digest-pinned verification evidence. Exact review leases use opaque owner/provider identifiers so external orchestrators remain optional and independent.
defaultPrompt: Use $define to create or revise an immutable provider-neutral work graph.
Use $orchestrate to dispatch every ready leaf in parallel-safe worktrees while preserving integration gates.
Resume by definition or provider alias and reuse only digest-valid verification evidence.
